tei:div.tei:p: )gu ru mi tra snying thig las: rnam dag bde chen smon lam bzhugs so: 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo: mi tra snying thig las: rnam dag bde chen zhing gi smon lam mi tra dzwa kis mdzad pa ni: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: mgon po 'od dpag med pa dang : snying rje can dang mthu chen thob: byang chub sems dpa' ma lus dgongs: bdag cag nam zhig 'chi 'phos gyur pa'i tshe: gshis ngan ma yin tshags su tshud pa dang : nad gcod chung zhing dbang po gsal ba dang : dngos kun ma chags chos nyid bde ldan shog: yi dam thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ste: bla ma dam pa rnams kyis lung bstan cing : rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis byin brlabs nas: chos skyong rnams kyis bar chad sel bar shog: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shul mtshon te: sems ma lha mo'i nam mkha' gang ba yis: sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas ni: nub phyogs bde ba can du 'khrid par shog: dpal gyi zhing rab bde ba can de na: bdag sogs dad pa'i stobs kyis phyin nas kyang : sa bcu byang sems lam lnga gcig char bsgrod: byang chub sems dpa'i gral du 'khod par shog: sangs rgyas zhing mchog bde ba can de ru: sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i zhabs drung du: padma'i ze'u 'bru mdzes pa'i gdan steng du: gzhon nu bde ldan rtag tu skye bar shog: sa bcu'i sems dpa' kun dang skal pa mnyam: sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i chos nyan cing : gdams pa'i bden pa mthong nas sangs rgyas thob: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing : dpal gyi zhing rab de na ni: thams cad padmor brdzus te skye: mngal sogs skye ba'i ming yang med: thams cad gzhon nu mdzes pa'i tshul: rgas shing 'khog pa'i ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs: na 'chi'i sdug bsngal ming yang med:

thams cad rdo rje'i tshe dang ldan: 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing : sa gzhi rin chen mnyam par brdal: ngam grog g.yang sa'i ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: 'phags pa'i sku las 'od 'phros pas: nyin dang mtshan mo'i ming yang med: yid bzhin zas kyis 'tsho bas na: bkres skom log 'tsho'i ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: 'jam mdzes padma'i 'od dang ldan: tsha grang sdug bsngal ming yang med: bde'o skyid do rnam dag zhing : ma dag 'khrul pa'i ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: dpal gyi zhing rab de na ni: thams cad nyon mongs sdug bsngal bral: pho mo chags sdang ming yang med: thams cad 'dzum zhing bde bar gnas: khro gtum 'thab rtsod ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: thams cad chos nyid bden pa brnyes: nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i ming yang med: thams cad yon tan phun sum tshogs: nyes dang skyon gyi ming yang med: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: mgon po 'od dpag med pa dang : mgon po thugs rje can rnams kyis: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: bde chen gnas su 'dren par shog: oṃ: 'jig rten mgon po la skyabs su mchi: 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs rjes gzigs: thugs rje'i lcags kyus rab bzung ste: bde chen gnas su skye bar shog: bde chen gnas su skyes gyur nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob nas: myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog: zhes bde chen zhing du skye ba'i smon lam mi tra dzwa kis mdzad pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: stag sham rdo rje'i gter ma'o:
